gist.headline: A voice in the garden
gist.blurb: What TTS has landed in video_audio, bringing an Arabic-first voice tool into the hive. It signs in with Pollinations OAuth right in the browser, because apparently even static pages can keep secrets properly now.
gist.summary: Added What TTS to the video_audio app catalog: a static Arabic RTL web app that implements the Pollinations.ai OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow entirely client-side.
gist.impact: Arabic-speaking builders can now discover and use What TTS through video_audio with right-to-left UI support and browser-based Pollinations authentication.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy Arabic-language voice garden: flowing right-to-left sound-wave glyphs rise from a small retro browser terminal while Polli warmly tends a microphone-shaped code-plant. The scene represents What TTS, client-side PKCE sign-in as a small key-and-lock bloom, and accessible Arabic RTL interaction rather than an abstract audio feature.
